name: Ganesh Chaturthi (Ganeshotsav) – Mumbai
note: 11-day festival from Ganesh Chaturthi to Anant Chaturdashi (lunar calendar). Huge crowds and road closures around pandals and immersion beaches (Girgaon Chowpatty, Juhu), especially on days 1.5, 5, 7 and 11. Also a cultural highlight.

name: Ganesh Chaturthi (Ganeshotsav) – Pune
note: Pune's Ganeshotsav centres on the old-city peths; Laxmi Road closes for the final-day procession that can run 24h+. Lunar-calendar dates.

name: Ellora-Ajanta International Festival
note: Classical music and dance festival organised by MTDC, held at Soneri Mahal. Held irregularly; dates are a placeholder — confirm with MTDC before relying on it.

name: Kala Ghoda Arts Festival
note: Nine-day free arts festival, usually starting the first Saturday of February (or last Saturday of January). Kala Ghoda streets get crowded; many free events.

name: Sawai Gandharva Bhimsen Mahotsav
note: Hindustani classical music festival, usually in the second week of December at Mukund Nagar/Ramanbaug grounds. Ticketed; dates announced ~Oct.
